title: BENCHMARKING BIAS MITIGATION TOWARD FAIRNESS WITHOUT HARM FROM VISION TO LVLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparity in classification performance (Accuracy Parity, Demographic Parity, Equalized Odds, and Max-Min Fairness) across male and female subgroups using facial image datasets (CelebA, FairFace, Facet) for both vision models and LVLMs.
Comparing classification parity metrics and worst-group accuracy across different racial and ethnic subgroups using the UTKFace and FairFace datasets.
Measuring disparity in medical image classification performance (AUC and parity metrics) across 'young' (0-60) and 'old' (60+) age groups using the HAM10000 dataset.
Evaluating fairness metrics and performance gaps in dermatological disease prediction across light (I-III) and dark (IV-VI) Fitzpatrick skin types using the Fitz17k dataset.

Testing model performance disparities caused by background contexts (water vs. land) using the Waterbirds dataset to evaluate whether models rely on confounding factors rather than core object features.
